indicators.name: Cash – 3-month spread
indicators.how: Positive = backwardation (prompt metal tight, spot buying costs more). Negative = contango (ample supply).

indicators.name: LME warehouse stocks
indicators.how: Falling stocks with rising prices point to real demand; rising stocks to oversupply.

indicators.name: Regional premiums
indicators.how: Japan (MJP), Rotterdam, US Midwest and Middle East duty-paid premiums sit on top of LME. They are paywalled, so they are not charted here; watch the 'Aluminium market' news filter.

indicators.name: Copper / aluminium ratio
indicators.how: A high ratio makes aluminium conductors and cables more attractive against copper.
